name: mapinski
description: Custom map creation and viewing app built on Mapbox, similar to Google My Maps.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@mapinski/server & npm run dev --workspace=@mapinski/client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mapinski/shared && npm run build --workspace=@mapinski/server && npm run build --workspace=@mapinski/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@mapinski/shared && npm run test --workspace=@mapinski/server && npm run test --workspace=@mapinski/client
